I was diagnosed with "Severe Chronic PTSD" a few years ago after returning from overseas. I was pretty close to "losing it" on several occasions when I would walk down that downward spiral. It usually was accompanied with insomnia and lots of drinking. After being unable to sleep for 4-5 days I went to the VA for the first time. Met an awesome MD (very hard to find good people in the VA depending on where you live I found) and we tried all kinds of things. After much trial and error and several double-blind studies I found something that worked! Tramadol... A mild pain killer I think is the label use. So mild in fact I think Tylenol works better as a pain killer. But for some reason it really helped with the depression, the anger and lack of motivation etc. Few years later, I'm still taking it but doubt I really need it anymore. Don't even feel the need to drink in a long time and haven't since except for the occasional social event I may have one drink.

Felt the need to share because I recommend it to every Vet I see and know that is going through the rough.
